Package jp.cssj.cti2.results

Class ResourceDirectoryResults

java.lang.Object
jp.cssj.cti2.results.ResourceDirectoryResults
All Implemented Interfaces:
Results
public class ResourceDirectoryResults extends Object implements Results
Stores multi-part results at the relative URI supplied in each result's metadata. Unlike DirectoryResults, this preserves resource paths such as pages/0001.svg and assets/fonts/font-0001.woff2.

The URI is treated as untrusted input. Absolute paths, traversal, fragments, queries, duplicate names and existing targets are rejected.

Since:
2.2
